theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.StageBounds.terminalChoices_log_rate :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.StageBounds.terminalChoices n : ℝ) / Real.log n) atTop
      (𝓝 (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Parameters.epsilon * (1 - _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Parameters.terminalFraction))) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $C_{\mathrm{term}}(n)$ be the terminal-choice count, $\varepsilon$ the inner-size fraction, and $\tau$ the terminal fraction. Then $$\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{\log C_{\mathrm{term}}(n)}{\log n}=\varepsilon(1-\tau).$$

Identifies the terminal combinatorial exponent in the runtime ledger. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
